erratum.note: Use the protocol with its published 2022 erratum, including corrected recording-montage language.

bestFor: Adult MSLT/MWT clinical preparation, prior-sleep and medication/substance planning, test selection context, technical preparation, standardized procedure performance, documentation, and reporting.

mappingRationale.D1A: Supports clinical preparation and relevant pretest history/sleep/medication context.
mappingRationale.D2A: Directly supports technical preparation, scheduling, test conditions, and required acquisition readiness.
mappingRationale.D2B: Directly addresses standardized administration and acquisition of adult MSLT/MWT procedures.
mappingRationale.D3C: Directly addresses documentation and standardized reporting of daytime testing.

authorityBoundary: Use instead of older adult MSLT/MWT procedural parameters where they differ. Apply the published 2022 erratum. Use the current AASM Scoring Manual for scoring/reporting rules outside this protocol's scope.
copyrightUse: Use citation, protocol topic headings, erratum awareness, original summaries, and learning objectives. Do not reproduce substantial protocol boxes, tables, figures, or protected text.
